title: Organisation Setup
subtitle: Configure your tenant, boundary, frameworks, and organisational hierarchy in {{count}} steps.

tenant.title: Tenant Configuration
tenant.desc: Company identity, fiscal year, base year, reporting currency

boundary.title: Organisational Boundary Approach
boundary.desc: Choose between operational control, financial control, or equity share

frameworks.title: Framework Selection
frameworks.desc: Select applicable reporting frameworks — GRI, CSRD, ISSB, TCFD, CDP

groups.title: Business Groups
groups.desc: Define top-level organisational groups for multi-entity consolidation

subdivisions.title: Subdivision Registration
subdivisions.desc: Register facilities, offices, and operational sites within each group

sources.title: Source Registration & Calculator Auto-Routing
sources.desc: Register emission sources and auto-assign GHG Protocol calculator modules

grid.title: Grid Subregion Mapping
grid.desc: Map facilities to electricity grid subregions for Scope 2 emission factors

done.title: Organisation setup complete
done.body: Your tenant, hierarchy, and frameworks are configured. You can now proceed to data collection.

tenant.infoBody: is used for SBTi target calculations and trend comparisons. Choose the earliest year with reliable GHG inventory data.

operational.title: Operational Control
operational.desc: Account for 100% of emissions from operations over which you have operational control. Most common approach.

financial.title: Financial Control
financial.desc: Account for 100% of emissions from operations over which you have financial control.

equity.title: Equity Share
equity.desc: Account for emissions proportional to your equity share in each operation.

frameworks.selected_one: {{count}} framework selected. Questionnaire modules will be generated based on your selection.
frameworks.selected_other: {{count}} frameworks selected. Questionnaire modules will be generated based on your selection.

sources.intro: Emission sources are auto-routed to the correct GHG Protocol calculator module based on type.

grid.intro: Map each facility to its electricity grid subregion for location-based Scope 2 emission factors.
grid.noteBody: are sourced from IEA/IPCC databases and updated annually. Market-based EFs from supplier contracts are managed separately.
